description: This Java class `PolicyEnforcers` provides static factory methods to create different types of `Enforcer` objects optimized for various use cases, such as default, throughput-optimized, and memory-optimized enforcers, based on a `Policy` object.

classes.name: PolicyEnforcers
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to instantiate different types of Policy enforcers based on performance and memory requirements.

methods.name: defaultEvaluator
methods.description: Creates a general-purpose, high-throughput Enforcer for the provided Policy.

methods.name: throughputOptimizedEvaluator
methods.description: Creates a high-throughput Enforcer optimized for complex Policies, utilizing Trie-based implementation.

methods.name: memoryOptimizedEvaluator
methods.description: Creates a memory-efficient Enforcer suitable for most Policies, using Tree-based implementation.
